description.en:
CourseCorrect: hired helpers that work your fields along a planned course, and helpers for the jobs around it.
- Stand on a field, see the course right away, press Start. Headlands, rows, smooth turns sized for your vehicle; every row, racetrack, lands, spiral or curved rows; islands worked round. - Course editor on the map: turn the rows, pick the start, leave rows or areas out, move points. - Fields painted with the landscaping tools are read from the ground. Vineyards and orchards. - Several tractors on one field: strips, lands, convoy or next free row; they make room for each other. - Unloader for combines and forage harvesters: AutoDrive's, set up from the panel (combine, where it unloads, AutoDrive's own settings); combines call it early and wait on the headland when the next row won't fit. Fuel and repair trips with AutoDrive, field chains across tractors (cultivate, sow, spray), contracts in one click. Bale collector and wrapper, silo compacter, loader (wheel loader, front loader). - Refills at a station or from supplies at the field edge; waits out the rain; balers follow the rake's course. - Planner for seed, fertiliser and fuel (with Precision Farming), alerts, fleet, work log, saved courses, import of Courseplay courses. - Works with AutoDrive. Multiplayer and dedicated servers.
Open the panel: Ctrl+J. Start/stop the helper: Alt+J.
Changelog 1.0.8.7: - Harvested sugarcane is no longer taken for standing crop: the game reports cut (and withered) fruit too, and a harvested cane lane read as crop. That made Start at Nearest back up a long way (66 m) and ways go round crop that wasn't there - Unloader panel: Front/back offset, AutoDrive Overdrive's new setting (od.60), next to Side offset Changelog 1.0.8.6: - The unloaders' arrows on the combine's map without a black square round them (their texture was written without transparency) Changelog 1.0.8.5: - A combine's AutoDrive unloaders on its course map: arrows the way they face, amber on their way or unloading, blue-grey waiting at the field's marker (at the map's edge when off it) - Start at: Nearest no longer backs up far for scattered bits of crop behind it (1.0.8.3 added up crop anywhere in the 60 m behind): it backs up only for a piece left standing right behind it, and only as far as that piece goes Changelog 1.0.8.4: - Clear: a button at the top left of the course map takes the course off the tractor, after asking first (Clear / Cancel). Saved courses stay - Square corners on headland passes without the hook: the reverse after the corner ended a metre past the pass's first points (or beside them, by a cut-off field corner), so the harvester jinked back or across before going on. It now ends on the pass's own line, just before it Changelog 1.0.8.3: - Start at: Nearest no longer drives off into the crop: since 1.0.7.1 it went back to the start of a pass with crop behind it (up to the whole side of the field), turning round through the cane to get there. Now it goes back only standing on that pass, lined up, and at most 60 m, backing straight up its own lane; crop is looked for on the pass's line itself (crop beside the lane doesn't count). Otherwise it starts where it is Changelog 1.0.8.2: - Start at First has a second switch, Then: where later starts of the same course begin once it has got going (Continue, Nearest, or First again). A new course starts at its first waypoint again. In My defaults too Changelog 1.0.8.1: - The AutoDrive unloader starts again after a server restart: a truck AutoDrive drove as the combine unloader when the game was saved is started again about 10 s after loading (AutoDrive's own autostart works only in single player). Off with After loading: Wait, now also on the Unloader panel Changelog 1.0.8.0: - Tank forecast (combines): it learns how many litres a metre brings. Full before the end of the row or pass: the AutoDrive unloader is called now, not only at the call level. A row the tank can't take: it waits for the unloader on the headland instead of standing full in the crop - Refuel at / Repair at (Settings, Driving; with AutoDrive): low on fuel or worn, the helper finishes the stretch it is on, AutoDrive takes it to the fuel station or workshop and brings it back, and it carries on where it stopped - Then, on this field (Settings, Driving): another tractor takes the field over when this course is done (cultivate, sow, spray): it gets its own course for the field and goes there, with AutoDrive when far - Contracts (Saved tab): the farm's running contracts; Make course gives this tractor a course on that field from anywhere, Go sends it there too - Setting values too long for their row are cut short instead of running over the - / + buttons Changelog 1.0.7.1: - Start at: Nearest left a piece of crop standing: started part-way along a pass (where the harvester stood after driving to it), the stretch behind it counted as done. With crop still standing behind it on that stretch, it now starts 6 m before the first of it (or at the stretch's start) Changelog 1.0.7.0: - The unloader is AutoDrive's now: CourseCorrect's own unloader driver is gone. The Unloader panel sets up AutoDrive's "unload combine" mode and keeps nothing itself: every row is AutoDrive's own setting, read from AutoDrive and written back through the server with AutoDrive's settings event, so AutoDrive's menu and the panel always show the same - Combine: the truck and the combine both get the AutoDrive marker of the combine's field as first target (one named after the field first): that is how AutoDrive pairs them, and where the truck waits. When the combine starts a course on another field, its trucks wait at that field's marker from then on - Unload at: an AutoDrive marker (the truck's second target). Leave when full at, Crop on the way, Side offset, Follow distance: AutoDrive's settings of the truck; Pipe side (Auto, Left, Behind, Right) and Second unloader: AutoDrive's settings of the combine - Start / Stop: AutoDrive's own start and stop, in unload combine mode (not without a combine and Unload at) - A combine of ours puts its pipe out for the truck AutoDrive sent it once that is within 60 m, and only stops for it when they would touch - Gone with it: unloading at the game's stations by its road driving, into a truck at the field edge, onto a heap Changelog 1.0.6.7: - Unloader started (or ended up) beside a standing combine with its trailer folded: every new way in was blocked by the combine at once, it used up its tries and stood short of its place. Now it first pulls out straight, slowly, up to 25 m: straight on, else 30 or 60 deg to either side, whichever is clear of the combine, of standing crop (with "Crop on the way" set to go round) and of the field's edge; once the trailer is straight it takes a new way in. At most 3 times per combine Changelog 1.0.6.6: - Unloader froze the server (0.3 to 0.4 s, "GuidanceVehicle:onUpdate") and stood behind the combine's corner: "combine right in front" was checked straight ahead, so every new way in counted as blocked and it planned again every 3 s, each plan asking the game about the crop thousands of times. Now checked along the way it will drive (a way turning off past the corner is free), each spot asked once per plan, the other ways to turn only looked at when the shortest crosses crop, and held up it waits longer before each new way (3, 6, 12, 24 s) Changelog 1.0.6.5: - Unloader started beside a standing combine with its trailer folded at an angle: it took itself as in place (the trailer's fill point near the pipe) and nothing flowed. In place now only with the trailer roughly straight behind (within 20 deg); folded, it takes a new way in, whose straight run-in straightens it - Problem report of an unloader: how far its trailer is folded Changelog 1.0.6.4: - Unloader full, leaving the combine: it drove into the combine on its way back (a stopped one counts as parked, nobody avoids it). The combine it served or just left is never driven into, and its ways go round it; held up by it 3 s, a new way - Unloader turning back: of the ways to turn, the one through the least crop (checked as wide as it is), not just the shortest (it turned into the standing cane and jackknifed) - Dropdown lists: the panel's text no longer shows through an open list - The camera no longer zooms when the mouse wheel scrolls a list or zooms the map over the panel Changelog 1.0.6.3: - Unloader with a trailer whose fill point (a mod's) lies 8 m to the side, off the trailer: it lined that point up under the pipe and the trailer stood 8 m away, nothing flowing. A fill point off its trailer gives way to the trailer's middle (said once in the log) - Helpers are as wide as they are for giving way and their ways (a trailer's markers made a truck "10 m wide") - Problem report of an unloader: where its fill point is Changelog 1.0.6.2: - Unloader lined up on the wrong side of a standing combine, 8 m from its place, nothing flowing: with the pipe folded, its side was a guess. The pipe now goes out as the unloader comes (a stopped combine's by the unloader, ours within 60 m), so it lines up where the pipe really is; and following a standing combine more than 2.5 m to the side of its place, it takes a new way in - Problem report: an unloader standing at its place says so ("the combine stands") Changelog 1.0.6.1: - Unloader: Combine (Any on its field, or one of your harvesters, with the field it is on). Picked, it serves only that one wherever it works; started away from that combine's field, AutoDrive takes it to the field's marker (one named after the field first) and it starts there - Dropdowns: click the value of Unload at, Combine, Pipe side, Crop on the way or AutoDrive marker for a list to pick from (the mouse wheel scrolls a long one) Changelog 1.0.6.0: - Unloader under a short pipe stood too far out for the crop to reach the trailer (since 1.0.5.7 it kept clear of the 5.5 m header). It keeps 0.6 m clear of the combine's body now; the way in still goes round the whole machine, header too - Problem report of an unloader: where it is against its place under the pipe (ahead, to the side, how far it points off), the combine's speed, pipe and discharge, the way left, its new ways in, what it waits for Changelog 1.0.5.9: - Unloader standing crosswise next to a standing combine, "unloading" for ever: near its place it took itself as lined up whichever way it pointed. Now only pointing the combine's way; crosswise it takes a new way in (straight run-in), a few times, then follows as it is Changelog 1.0.5.8: - Unloader circling behind a standing combine: it planned a new way every few seconds from halfway round the last one. Now only when the combine has moved on a fair part of the way - Unloader driving into the combine on its way in (stuck): its ways go round the combine it serves (body and header), like round standing crop - Unloader: Pipe side (Auto: where the pipe is measured / Left / Right) - A stopped combine's engine is started when the unloader opens its pipe (the game won't move the pipe with the engine off) Changelog 1.0.5.7: - Unloader under a short pipe (a sugarcane harvester's): the truck's cab drove into the harvester. Its place beside the combine is now always at least 0.6 m clear of the combine's widest part (its header), whatever the pipe's reach or the side offset - Unloader following under the pipe: it stops for anything else in its way (another truck, a player); it only did on the way there Changelog 1.0.5.6: - Unloader at a combine that isn't worked by CourseCorrect right now (stopped, stopped itself full, driven by you): it stood under the pipe and nothing came out. Now it opens the combine's pipe and starts the flow into its trailer itself, and folds the pipe again when it leaves Changelog 1.0.5.5: - Unloader: Side offset (out from the combine +, in -, 0.25 m steps) and Front/back offset (forward +, back -, 0.5 m steps) for its place under the pipe, changed while it works too; click the value for 0 - Unloader with a long trailer behind a combine: it went round in circles (each new way in a loop round its wide radius). Roughly behind its place already, it follows from there Changelog 1.0.5.4: - Unloader trucks with a semi-trailer: their ways planned with the cab's tight turning radius (4.4 m) made the trailer cut in and the truck jackknife and get stuck. Now wide enough for what they pull (12 m trailer: 9 m), and a longer straight run-in behind the combine Changelog 1.0.5.3: - Switching vehicles with Tab: the panel goes with you (same tab, minimised stays minimised) instead of closing; out of the vehicle it closes - Problem report of an unloader: the stations Unload at can pick, and why the game's other stations are left out Changelog 1.0.5.2: - A harvester stood still for its unloader waiting beside its line (the truck's measured work width, 10 m, made it look in the way). Helpers without a course now count by their own size and what they pull - Problem report and overlay: a helper standing says why (rain, AutoDrive holding it, the implements can't go on and which, lowering, paused...) - An unloader (bale collector, silo compacter, loader) working when the game was saved starts again as that after loading, with its settings. It started the field course the vehicle also had instead (a truck drove an old 10 m course across the field). Saves from before this: the game's own last job tells Changelog 1.0.5.1: - AutoDrive truck in the way: after waiting 20 s for it, the helper drove on into it. Now it goes on only up to it and stops short, till it moves. Its trailer counts too (only the truck was looked at), and a moving AutoDrive truck is never driven into either. The helper's front is measured (a harvester's header reaches further than a tractor's nose) Changelog 1.0.5.0: - Unloader waiting on a combine's line (started on its headland pass): the combine, held up by it, calls it at once, below its call level too; it takes what there is and both go on (both waited for ever). The combine still gives way to its unloader while it comes round from in front - The log no longer calls our own unloader AutoDrive's ("has stood in our way for 20 s: going on", every 20 s) Changelog 1.0.4.9: - Helpers waiting for the others (unloader waiting for a combine, silo compacted, wrapper waiting for the baler): the engine off after 10 s to save fuel, on again as soon as they have to move - Unloader: Unload at, Leave when full at and the new Crop on the way (Go round / Drive through) can be changed while it works - Course map: drag it with the mouse when zoomed in (it stays there until zoomed again) Changelog 1.0.4.8: - Square corners next to a cut-off corner of the field: the manoeuvre turned by the points beside the corner (pushed in off the edges there) instead of by the edges: a skewed turn, backing up far across the passes (up to 45 m into the crop), the corner partly missed. Now it turns by the edges, a short reverse along them - The status at the top of the panel no longer covers the vehicle's name (shortened, or left out when there is no room) - Course map zoom: – and + on the map, or the mouse wheel over it; up to 8 times closer, following the vehicle - Minimised panel: Start / Pause / Stop buttons. Ctrl+J gives the mouse to the small panel (to click them) and back to the game; the + brings the whole panel back Changelog 1.0.4.7: - Go / Go there / the queue: AutoDrive takes it to the field's own marker (one at the field's edge named after the field, e.g. Field 42b WAIT), not the nearest marker to the course's start (a silo beside the field, where it unfolded everything). AutoDrive marker: Automatic shows which marker that is - Minimise (the – at the top of the panel): only the header, the progress and the course map stay, and the mouse goes back to the game; Ctrl+J brings the whole panel back - Start and End flags on the course lines in the world (green and red, as on the panel's map), while the panel is open (minimised too) Changelog 1.0.4.6: - Start at: Nearest with a harvester: the passes already harvested are left out, it starts on the nearest one with crop standing (it worked down a pass done before) Changelog 1.0.4.5: - Moving from one headland pass to the next with a long harvester: swinging wide in the S-bend, it took that for being pushed off its line, lifted and drove back across the field, leaving a strip standing. Not near those moves any more Changelog 1.0.4.4: - Square corners with a long harvester: lowered still a few metres off the next line after backing up, it took that for being pushed off its line, lifted and drove back, leaving the corner standing. Now only when it was on its line and got pushed off it, and not at a corner's stop Changelog 1.0.4.3: - The game's own helper hired for a vehicle with a CourseCorrect course, at that course's field (the hire key restarts the game's field work job the savegame remembers, AutoDrive with its helper set to the game's): CourseCorrect works the course instead. New setting Game's helper here (Settings, Driving; My defaults): CourseCorrect drives (default) or The game's helper Changelog 1.0.4.2: - Problem report of a harvester: how AutoDrive sees it (its target, call level, tank, pipe, working or idle, the truck sent) and every AutoDrive unloader with its target, to see why no truck comes Changelog 1.0.4.1: - The problem report names the helper job driving the vehicle, and says when it is not CourseCorrect's (the game's own helper, another mod's) Changelog 1.0.4.0: - Square corners with a header in front: it backs up 2 m further before driving on (it still stopped short and left the start of the next lane) Changelog 1.0.3.9: - When lifted (Settings, Driving; My defaults): Switch off (as before) or Keep running: lifted in turns and from one pass to the next, the implements keep running - Square corners with a header in front: it harvests on up to where it backs up (the last metres before the corner were left standing) Changelog 1.0.3.8: - Square corners with a header in front (harvesters): it backs up far enough that the header starts at the corner (the first 4 m past each corner were left standing) - Pushed off its line while working (a truck in the way): it goes back to where it left it, instead of on 30 m further along (it missed that much) - The problem report says what is driving the vehicle (CourseCorrect, the game's helper, AutoDrive) Changelog 1.0.3.1 to 1.0.3.7: - A harvester full with nobody to unload it says so (red alert, notification): start an unloader, or give an AutoDrive truck the same first target - A standing AutoDrive truck in the way (e.g. after unloading, when the harvester turns) is waited for, at most 20 s - Course line height (My defaults): the course lines in the world on the ground, or 1, 2.5 (8 ft) or 4 m up to see them over tall crops - Lowered but not switched on (the game refused it, e.g. the pipe still moving after unloading): asked again, so it no longer stands there for ever - Fixed: an error while saving the game (a setting not set yet), which could leave the rest of the vehicle unsaved - The problem report has the field's outline (a field read from the ground can then be made again) - From one headland pass to the next the implement stays down (switched off) instead of lifting, and the move over is short (it drifted along the pass just done for up to 100 m); a harvester keeps running on it - Call unloader at, the speeds, the lower / raise timing and In the rain can be changed while the helper works - Unloading on the move: at the call level the pipe goes out (with unloaders about), so AutoDrive's truck can empty it as it goes - A truck leaving full with grain still in the combine: the combine calls the next one at once - Harvester with an AutoDrive unloader: no longer stuck beside it after unloading (the pipe stays out till the tank is empty; a hold with nothing coming out lasts at most 15 s) - Unloader: after emptying a combine it no longer stands beside it (the two waited for each other): it lets the combine pull away and goes back to where it waits, or off to unload when the trailer has no room for another load - Start away from the course's field: asks, and AutoDrive takes it there (folded, CP on) and it starts on arrival - The panel's colours as designed (it was paler and grey in the game) - Help in the panel (the ?): how to use it, on the topic of where you are - Queue view: the queued courses in order, move, go, remove, clear - Go: sends the tractor to a saved course now; the implements are folded, AutoDrive drives it to the course's marker and starts CourseCorrect there - AutoDrive marker per course (Settings, Driving) - Fixed: a helper with an unfolded implement didn't start ("not in transport mode") - Icon redrawn
description.de:
CourseCorrect: Helfer, die deine Felder entlang eines geplanten Kurses bearbeiten, und Helfer für die Arbeit drumherum.
- Auf ein Feld stellen, Kurs sofort sehen, Start drücken. Vorgewende, Bahnen, weiche Wenden passend zum Fahrzeug; jede Bahn, Rennbahn, Beete, Spirale oder gebogene Bahnen; Inseln werden umfahren. - Kurseditor auf der Karte: Bahnen drehen, Start wählen, Bahnen oder Flächen auslassen, Punkte verschieben. - Mit den Landschaftswerkzeugen gemalte Felder werden vom Boden gelesen. Weinberge und Obstplantagen. - Mehrere Traktoren auf einem Feld: Streifen, Beete, Kolonne oder nächste freie Bahn; sie machen einander Platz. - Überlader für Drescher und Häcksler: der von AutoDrive, in der Ansicht eingestellt (Drescher, Abladeort, Einstellungen von AutoDrive selbst). Ballensammler und -wickler, Siloverdichter, Lader (Radlader, Frontlader). - Nachfüllen an einer Station oder aus Vorräten am Feldrand; wartet Regen ab; Pressen folgen dem Kurs des Schwaders. - Planer für Saatgut, Dünger und Kraftstoff (mit Precision Farming), Hinweise, Fuhrpark, Arbeitsbuch, gespeicherte Kurse, Import von Courseplay-Kursen. - Arbeitet mit AutoDrive. Mehrspieler und dedizierte Server.
Panel öffnen: Strg+J. Helfer starten/stoppen: Alt+J.
Änderungen 1.0.8.7: - Geerntetes Zuckerrohr gilt nicht mehr als stehender Bestand: Das Spiel meldet auch geschnittene (und verwelkte) Frucht, eine abgeerntete Rohrbahn galt als Bestand. Deshalb setzte Start bei Nächster weit zurück (66 m) und Wege fuhren um Bestand herum, der nicht da war - Ansicht Überlader: Versatz vor/zurück, die neue Einstellung von AutoDrive Overdrive (od.60), neben dem seitlichen Versatz Änderungen 1.0.8.6: - Die Pfeile der Überlader auf der Karte des Dreschers ohne schwarzes Quadrat drumherum (ihre Textur war ohne Transparenz geschrieben) Änderungen 1.0.8.5: - Die AutoDrive-Überlader eines Dreschers auf seiner Kurskarte: Pfeile in Fahrtrichtung, orange unterwegs oder beim Überladen, blaugrau wartend am Ziel des Feldes (am Kartenrand, wenn außerhalb) - Start bei: Nächster fährt nicht mehr weit zurück wegen verstreuter Bestandsreste hinter sich (1.0.8.3 zählte Bestand irgendwo in den 60 m dahinter): Er setzt nur zurück für ein Stück, das direkt hinter ihm stehen geblieben ist, und nur so weit, wie es reicht Änderungen 1.0.8.4: - Löschen: ein Knopf oben links auf der Kurskarte nimmt dem Traktor den Kurs, nach einer Rückfrage (Löschen / Abbrechen). Gespeicherte Kurse bleiben - Eckige Ecken auf Vorgewendebahnen ohne Haken: Das Rückwärtsfahren nach der Ecke endete einen Meter hinter den ersten Punkten der Bahn (oder neben ihnen, an einer abgeschnittenen Feldecke), die Erntemaschine ruckte zurück oder quer, bevor sie weiterfuhr. Jetzt endet es auf der Linie der Bahn, kurz davor Änderungen 1.0.8.3: - Start bei: Nächster fährt nicht mehr in den Bestand: Seit 1.0.7.1 fuhr er bei Bestand hinter sich zurück zum Anfang der Bahn (bis zu einer ganzen Feldseite) und wendete dafür durch das Zuckerrohr. Jetzt fährt er nur zurück, wenn er auf dieser Bahn steht, ausgerichtet, und höchstens 60 m, gerade rückwärts in seiner eigenen Spur; Bestand wird auf der Linie der Bahn selbst gesucht (Bestand neben der Spur zählt nicht). Sonst startet er, wo er steht Änderungen 1.0.8.2: - Start bei Anfang hat einen zweiten Schalter, Danach: wo spätere Starts desselben Kurses beginnen, sobald er läuft (Weiter, Nächster oder wieder Anfang). Ein neuer Kurs beginnt wieder am ersten Wegpunkt. Auch in Meine Vorgaben Änderungen 1.0.8.1: - Der AutoDrive-Überlader startet nach einem Server-Neustart wieder: Ein LKW, den AutoDrive beim Speichern als Überlader fuhr, wird etwa 10 s nach dem Laden wieder gestartet (der eigene Autostart von AutoDrive gilt nur im Einzelspieler). Aus mit Nach dem Laden: Warten, jetzt auch in der Ansicht Überlader Änderungen 1.0.8.0: - Bunker-Vorschau (Drescher): Er lernt, wie viele Liter ein Meter bringt. Voll vor dem Ende der Fahrgasse oder Vorgewendebahn: Der AutoDrive-Überlader wird jetzt gerufen, nicht erst beim Ruf-Füllstand. Eine Fahrgasse, die der Bunker nicht mehr fasst: Er wartet am Vorgewende auf den Überlader, statt voll im Bestand zu stehen - Tanken bei / Reparieren bei (Einstellungen, Fahren; mit AutoDrive): Wenig Kraftstoff oder verschlissen, beendet der Helfer den Abschnitt, AutoDrive fährt ihn zur Tankstelle oder Werkstatt und zurück, und er macht dort weiter, wo er aufgehört hat - Danach, auf diesem Feld (Einstellungen, Fahren): Ein anderer Traktor übernimmt das Feld, wenn dieser Kurs fertig ist (Grubbern, Säen, Spritzen): Er bekommt seinen eigenen Kurs für das Feld und fährt hin, weit weg mit AutoDrive - Aufträge (Reiter Gespeichert): die laufenden Aufträge des Hofs; Kurs erstellen gibt diesem Traktor von überall einen Kurs auf dem Feld, Los schickt ihn auch hin - Zu lange Werte in einer Einstellungszeile werden gekürzt, statt über die Knöpfe - / + zu laufen Änderungen 1.0.7.1: - Start bei: Nächste ließ ein Stück Bestand stehen: Mitten auf einer Bahn gestartet (wo die Erntemaschine nach der Anfahrt stand), galt das Stück dahinter als erledigt. Steht dahinter auf diesem Abschnitt noch Bestand, startet sie jetzt 6 m vor dessen Anfang (oder am Anfang des Abschnitts) Änderungen 1.0.7.0: - Der Überlader ist jetzt der von AutoDrive: CourseCorrects eigener Überlader-Fahrer ist weg. Die Ansicht Überlader stellt den Modus "Drescher entladen" von AutoDrive ein und speichert selbst nichts: Jede Zeile ist eine Einstellung von AutoDrive selbst, von AutoDrive gelesen und über den Server mit dem Einstellungs-Event von AutoDrive zurückgeschrieben, so zeigen das Menü von AutoDrive und die Ansicht immer dasselbe - Drescher: LKW und Drescher bekommen beide das AutoDrive-Ziel am Feld des Dreschers als erstes Ziel (eines, das nach dem Feld benannt ist, zuerst): So paart AutoDrive sie, und dort wartet der LKW. Startet der Drescher einen Kurs auf einem anderen Feld, warten seine LKWs ab dann am Ziel dieses Feldes - Abladen bei: ein AutoDrive-Ziel (das zweite Ziel des LKWs). Fährt los bei, Bestand im Weg, Seitlicher Versatz, Folgeabstand: Einstellungen von AutoDrive für den LKW; Rohrseite (Auto, Links, Dahinter, Rechts) und Zweiter Überlader: Einstellungen von AutoDrive für den Drescher - Start / Stopp: Start und Stopp von AutoDrive selbst, im Modus Drescher entladen (nicht ohne Drescher und Abladen bei) - Ein Drescher von uns schwenkt das Rohr für den LKW aus, den AutoDrive ihm geschickt hat, sobald der näher als 60 m ist, und hält für ihn nur, wenn sie sich berühren würden - Damit entfällt: Abladen an Stationen des Spiels über dessen Straßenfahrt, in einen LKW am Feldrand, auf einen Haufen Änderungen 1.0.6.7: - Überlader neben einem stehenden Drescher gestartet (oder dort gelandet), der Auflieger eingeknickt: jeder neue Weg hinein war sofort vom Drescher blockiert, er verbrauchte seine Versuche und blieb vor seiner Position stehen. Jetzt fährt er zuerst langsam bis zu 25 m gerade heraus: geradeaus, sonst 30 oder 60 Grad zu einer Seite, je nachdem, was frei ist von Drescher, stehendem Bestand (wenn er ihn umfahren soll) und Feldrand; ist der Auflieger gerade, nimmt er einen neuen Weg hinein. Höchstens 3 Mal pro Drescher Änderungen 1.0.6.6: - Überlader ließ den Server hängen (0,3 bis 0,4 s, "GuidanceVehicle:onUpdate") und stand hinter der Ecke des Dreschers: "Drescher direkt vor uns" wurde geradeaus geprüft, jeder neue Weg galt als blockiert, alle 3 s ein neuer Plan mit tausenden Abfragen zum Bestand. Jetzt entlang des Wegs geprüft (ein Weg, der an der Ecke vorbei abbiegt, ist frei), jede Stelle einmal pro Plan abgefragt, die anderen Wendemöglichkeiten nur, wenn die kürzeste durch Bestand führt, und aufgehalten wartet er vor jedem neuen Weg länger (3, 6, 12, 24 s) Änderungen 1.0.6.5: - Überlader neben einem stehenden Drescher gestartet, der Auflieger schräg eingeknickt: er hielt sich für in Position (der Füllpunkt des Aufliegers nahe am Rohr) und nichts lief über.
